THE ENVIRONMENTAL STANDARD
What is ISO 45001?

ISO 45001 is the international standard for occupational health and safety management systems (OHSMS). It replaces the older OHSAS 18001 standard and provides a framework for organisations to systematically manage risks to workers' health and safety.
 

Unlike general safety guidelines, ISO 45001 creates accountability through documented processes, management responsibility, and continuous improvement. It applies to organisations of any size and across any industry, from small manufacturing facilities to large construction projects to office-based technology companies.

Plan; Identify hazards

Assess risks, and set OH&S objectives

Do; Implement controls

Document processes, and train workers

sections.text:
WHY ISO 45001 MATTERS FOR YOUR BUSINESS?

Safety is a business imperative. Here's why Australian organisations invest in ISO 45001

Reduce Workplace Incidents and Costs

Work-related injuries and illness have financial and human costs. ISO 45001 systematically identifies hazards before they cause harm, reducing incidents, workers' compensation claims, and insurance premiums
 

Attract and Retain Talented Staff

Employees want to work for organisations that protect their wellbeing. A strong OH&S culture improves retention, reduces absenteeism, and boosts morale.
 

Meet Legal and Regulatory Obligations

Australian workplaces must comply with the Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Cth) and state-based WHS legislation. ISO 45001 provides the documented framework to demonstrate compliance with these legal duties, protecting your organisation and its leaders.

Improve Operational Efficiency

Safe operations are efficient operations. When hazards are controlled, processes documented, and workers trained, downtime decreases and productivity increases.

Build Trust with Clients and Partners

Many commercial contracts now require ISO 45001 certification, especially in construction, mining, defence, and manufacturing. It signals to clients and partners that your organisation takes safety seriously and can be trusted with high-risk work.

ALL DOCUMENTATION CUSTOMIZED TO YOUR INDUSTRY AND BUSINESS NEEDS

integPRO'S ISO 45001 APPROACH

We don't believe in one-size-fits-all templates. We build systems that fit your business.

Discovery & Assessment

We visit your workplace, interview staff across all levels, and understand your current hazards, controls, and gaps. This gives us the full picture.
 

Roadmap & Planning

We develop a realistic implementation roadmap tailored to your operations, timeline, and resources. We're honest about effort required.
 

Documentation Development

We draft your OH&S policy, procedures, hazard registers, and compliance documentation—customised to your industry and risk profile.

​Worker Engagement

We facilitate worker consultation sessions to capture frontline insights and build buy-in for the system. Safety only works if workers trust it.

Training & Roll-Out

We train your team on the new system, explain the "why" behind each process, and support the transition to daily practice.
 

Internal Audit Preparation

We conduct mock audits against the ISO 45001 standard, identify remaining gaps, and prepare your team for certification audits.

ISO 45001 Across Industries

​ISO 45001 is essential in high-risk and regulated industries:

Defence

Defence contractors must meet strict security and safety protocols. ISO 45001 often integrates with DISP compliance requirements.
 

Healthcare

Medical device manufacturers operate under strict quality and safety standards. ISO 45001 complements ISO 13485 certification.

 

Manufacturing

Chemical handling, machinery operation, repetitive strain, and complex workflows demand rigorous hazard control and incident prevention.
 

Professional Services

Even low-hazard environments face ergonomic risks, mental health considerations, and emergency response protocols. ISO 45001 provides the framework.
 

Construction

Hazard-intensive environments with multiple contractors, complex equipment, and weather exposure. ISO 45001 is increasingly required by principal contractors and clients.

Education & Training

Effective ISO 45001 implementation depends on your workforce understanding the system and their role in it. We provide comprehensive training to ensure adoption and engagement.

Not sure if ISO 14001 applies to your industry?

ISO 45001 isn't just a checkbox, it's a commitment to your workforce and your business. At integPRO, we've helped construction firms, manufacturers, mining operations, and defence contractors build systems that keep people safe and operations running smoothly.
